title: SAVA Gelaro S4 GRX400 factory listing and destination policy
notes: Exact GRX400 2x10 complete-bike listing shows USD 1799 for the visible grey/47 cm factory option. Its shipping table explicitly covers EU countries, UK, USA and Mexico and claims free shipping with duties prepaid. The checkout-calculated shipping label remains visible, so final destination-specific totals are unverified. Canada and non-EU Europe are not established by this evidence.
